Merged {3,5} objects – with changes in MODIFIED that were successfully merged with any changes from TARGET into RESULT. Conflict {4,5} objects – with changes in both MODIFIED and TARGET that could only be merged partially. Partially merged objects and corresponding .CONFLICT files are added to RESULT. This also includes objects that are deleted in MODIFIED/TARGET and changed in TARGET/MODIFIED. Inserted {5,5} objects – in MODIFIED that do not exist in TARGET and are inserted into RESULT. Unchanged {7,5} objects – in TARGET which are not changed in MODIFIED and are copied from TARGET to RESULT. This also include objects deleted in both MODIFIED and TARGET and objects unchanged in MODIFIED and deleted in TARGET. Failed {8,5} objects – that could not be imported, such as an object that is not valid or that contains unsupported features.
